title: A colimit decomposition for the loop homology of polyhedral products
summary: We show that the loop homology algebras of polyhedral products of the form $(\underline{X},\underline{*})^{\mathcal{K}}$ can be written as a colimit over the flagification of $\mathcal{K}$, and obtain a similar result for the Poincaré series. This effectively reduces the study of the algebras $H_*(Ω(\underline{X},\underline{*})^{\mathcal{K}})$ to the case of 1-neighbourly simplicial complexes.
